title: Decompose cross-cutting enablers in the goal mappings
requirements:
- Replace the single interoperability box with its underlying services (discovery, trust, routing, validation, semantics, mapping)
- Replace a single consent or privacy box with distinct capabilities: legal basis, authorisation, consent/preference, audit, data rights
- Split legal identity, health person identification, authentication, credentials, authorisation and record linkage
- Make SGI and governed semantic artefacts (profiles, mappings, data dictionaries) visible where components depend on them
- Show trust enablers (governance, security, legal authority, accountability) as explicit capabilities
- Make the foundational DPI dependency list explicitly non-exhaustive and context-specific
- Include provenance, units, status and timing as semantic requirements where clinical data is exchanged
- Map purpose-specific minimum datasets and restricted access where goals reuse personal data
